title: Can ChatGPT evaluate research environments? Evidence from REF2021

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing Spearman and Pearson correlations between ChatGPT-generated scores and human expert evaluation scores across 34 different academic Units of Assessment (UoAs) to identify inconsistencies and performance discrepancies across fields (e.g., STEM vs. Arts & Humanities).

Conducting a content analysis on ChatGPT's textual justifications for scores of 3.5 or below to identify its disproportionate reliance on absolute research income, funding scale, and unit size rather than contextual norm-referencing.

Evaluating the potential for LLMs to generate positively skewed scores for well-known institutions by associating text with institutional press releases and promotional materials present in the model's general training data.
